scenes.title: AI UPDATE
scenes.narration: Welcome to AI Update. I’m Dr. Chris. We track cloud AI and help you choose.

cues.text: Source-library chip artwork reveals with a slow zoom.

scenes.title: Cloud models. Your task. Your budget.
scenes.narration: From the major AI companies, we focus on the model that fits your task, and what it costs to use.

cues.text: Eleven cloud company and model-family identities reveal in staggered groups.
Your task and your budget remain the visual focus.

scenes.visual: Distinct generated server-room technology illustration, with the eleven unaltered source-library logo marks and names.

scenes.title: What benchmarks measure
scenes.narration: For coding, writing, and reasoning, we explain what benchmarks measure, what they miss, and why a single score cannot answer every question.

cues.text: Robot and workstation illustration establishes task context.
Test and conditions statement gains emphasis.

scenes.title: Same prompt. Different models.
scenes.purpose: Fair comparisons and total task cost
scenes.narration: Then we compare models using the same prompt, showing actual responses, task success, and total cost. Our goal: useful results at a sensible price.

cues.text: Genuine Rive comparison graphic establishes the comparison structure.
Total cost receives a warm accent and emphasis.

scenes.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
scenes.narration: On October seventh, Anthropic introduced Claude Haiku five point five for high-volume tasks. We’ll examine how its results compare with its cost.

cues.text: Claude logo and Haiku 5.5 headline reveal.
Evidence and task cost remain the criteria for future assessment.
